name: split fusion plus harm gate
base: frozen MM design, codex/mm-judge 92d6e72a7db8352107069eafef42586a9680d62f, contract c576033232a7643d52a2b8a2d295e26f79a6b26a: native direct, chat-only three-sample vote
pointwise_reader: research/opus-mm/pointwise.py SYSTEM, sha256 prefix 1c75addd2fcc89f4, one blind call per reply, model haiku
rule_1_split_fusion: if the two frozen games disagree (one A one B, or any tie with no majority), the sign of overall(A) minus overall(B) decides; zero stays a tie
rule_2_harm_gate: if the mean of request_harmful over the two reads is at least 0.5 and exactly one reply has reply_refuses true, that reply wins; applied to every subset, after rule 1
replication: DEV items outside DEV400, seed opus-mm-replication-v1, proportional by class, processed in seeded hash order

preregistered_arm_machine_solve.registered_before_any_result: committed before solve.py made a single call; split fusion plus harm gate was frozen at 18d56884 before the replication started
preregistered_arm_machine_solve.solver: research/opus-mm/solve.py: one blind Haiku call writes a Python program from the request only; code runs it (python3 -I, 10 s timeout); a reply's final is its last number
preregistered_arm_machine_solve.verdict_order: 1 harm gate fires: refusing reply wins; 2 machine solve decides (program ran, exactly one reply final equals the computed answer): that reply wins; 3 frozen orders agree: that winner; 4 split: sign of pointwise overall difference; 5 else tie
preregistered_arm_machine_solve.scope: reasoning items only for the solver; all other rules unchanged
preregistered_arm_machine_solve.bar: total at least +1.0 points over frozen, paired 95% within-class bootstrap interval excluding zero, no class down more than 1.0 point; exact two-sided sign test reported

bar_primary: split fusion plus harm gate: same bar as the solve arm
stopped_arms: fitted heads and the English-view majority are not part of any replication arm
